title: Fixed-source cylinder prism in a relative join
statement:
Use simplicial sets, products, degreewise pushouts, standard simplices and coherent transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], right join cones of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], and relative joins with their structure maps and canonical inclusions of [def-coef-infinity-relative-join]. Let $Z,X$ be simplicial sets in a fixed universe and let $x:\Delta^0\to X$ be a vertex. Put $C_Z=\Delta^0\amalg_{Z\times\{0\}}(Z\times\Delta^1)$, where the first map collapses $Z\times\{0\}$ to the point $p$. Denote the quotient map by $c:Z\times\Delta^1\to C_Z$ and its top endpoint by $c_1:Z\to C_Z$. Put $K=(Z\times X)\amalg_{Z}C_Z$, gluing $z\mapsto(z,x)$ to $c_1$. Write $j:Z\times X\to K$ and $k:C_Z\to K$ for its maps. Let $a:K\to X$ restrict to the projection on $Z\times X$ and the constant map at $x$ on $C_Z$. Put $T=K\star_X X$ for $a$ and $1_X$, with inclusions $i_K,i_X$ and structure map $\pi:T\to X$, and write $v$ for the apex of $Z^{\triangleright}$.

There exist simplicial maps $P:Z^{\triangleright}\times X\to T$ over $X$ and $J:Z^{\triangleright}\times\Delta^1\to T$ over the constant vertex $x$, with the following exact restrictions:
$$P|_{Z\times X}=i_Kj,\qquad P|_{\{v\}\times X}=i_X,$$
$$J|_{Z^{\triangleright}\times\{0\}}=i_K k(p),\qquad J|_{Z^{\triangleright}\times\{1\}}=P|_{Z^{\triangleright}\times\{x\}},\qquad J|_{Z\times\Delta^1}=i_Kkc.$$
Moreover $J|_{\{v\}\times\Delta^1}$ is the relative-join edge from $k(p)$ in the initial $K$ to $x$ in the final $X$, with its degeneracies. The same conclusions hold when $Z$ is empty. No quasicategory, fibration, filteredness or colimit hypothesis is imposed.
